district-church-dc.assessment: District Church is a multicultural, non-denominational congregation in Washington, DC founded by Aaron Graham in 2010. Graham holds a doctorate from Fuller Seminary and a public policy degree from Harvard. The church affirms Trinitarian theology and appears Christ-centered. However, several yellow flags: no explicit inerrancy statement, no visible elder/accountability structure, no men's ministry, and non-denominational independence means no external doctrinal guardrails. The church's heavy involvement in social causes (foster care, affordable housing) is commendable but requires verification that the gospel remains central rather than being displaced by social advocacy. No female pastors identified, but no explicit complementarian position either. Needs in-person evaluation to assess preaching depth and doctrinal rigor.

score_notes.christology: Affirms Trinitarian theology: one true, holy God eternally existing in three persons — Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Orthodox Christology.
score_notes.scripture: No explicit inerrancy statement found on website. Beliefs page not accessible. Founder has Fuller Seminary doctorate — Fuller does not require inerrancy affirmation. Yellow until verified.
score_notes.gender: Amy Graham holds the title 'Spiritual Care Pastor' — one of four pastoral positions listed on the staff page. Female pastor confirmed; rubric specifies red for women in pastoral roles.
score_notes.leadership: Lead pastor model with Aaron Graham as founder. No elder board or accountability structure publicly visible. Non-denominational with no external denominational accountability.
score_notes.soteriology: Christ-centered gospel presentation. No works-based salvation indicators. Appears to present salvation by grace through faith.
score_notes.cultural: Describes itself as multicultural (80+ nations represented). Involved in foster care, adoption, and affordable housing advocacy through DC127. Some social justice engagement — need to verify whether gospel remains central or is displaced by social causes.
score_notes.denominational: Independent non-denominational with female pastor on staff — no conservative confessional accountability; placing in red per rubric given egalitarian practice combined with non-denom independence.
score_notes.preaching: Unable to verify preaching style from website alone. Fuller Seminary training suggests academic foundation but does not confirm expository commitment.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No dedicated men's ministry found on website or in search results. Red for lack of intentional male discipleship.
score_notes.mission: Strong outreach emphasis — DC127 foster care ministry, community engagement, multicultural congregation. Great Commission language present.
